Solid Brass Door Hinges

Our solid brass door hinges and brass hinge finials are available in up to 10 different finish colors including PVD lifetime polished brass, oil rubbed bronze, satin nickel, brushed or polished chrome. Sizes from 3" x 3" to 6" x 6" - high quality solid brass.
